newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila July volume of production index up 5.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila July volume of production index up 5.2 pct.

text.p: Philippine manufacturing output in terms of value rose in the month of July, the National Statistics Office (NSO) said on Tuesday.
The July value of production index rose by 5.2 percent year-on-year to 427.7 from 406.7 in the same month last year, the NSO said.
Among the 16 major industries surveyed by the NSO, nine gained in terms of value.

The biggest was posted by the food manufacturing sector with a growth of 32.7 percent from last year's levels due to the higher production of sugar, coconut products and bakery products, the NSO said.
This was followed by beverage at 26.5 percent; electrical machinery, 20.7; and petroleum products, 13.0.
The agency said the volume of production index rose 1.3 percent to 144.6 from 142.7 in the same month last year.
In terms of volume, food manufacturing likewise was the biggest gainer with a year-on-year growth of 21.9 percent. Next was beverage with 20.2 percent; and electrical machinery, 18.8.
